questions:
1. **Range, step, default and presets.** An issue comment signed "product-owner-excal" gives range 0.8–3.0, step 0.05, default 1.25, presets Tight = 1.0, Normal = 1.25, Loose = 1.75. Suggested: accept these values, confirmed by you here (the comment itself is unverified).
2. **Typed value out of range or invalid** (e.g. 0.5, 3.5, 1.33, "abc", empty, comma decimal "1,5"). Suggested: values below 0.8 / above 3.0 clamp to 0.8 / 3.0; off-step values round to the nearest 0.05 (1.33 → 1.35); non-numeric or empty input is rejected and the previous value stays; "1,5" is accepted as 1.5.
3. **Where the typed field lives and its label.** Suggested: next to the presets in the properties panel under a section "Line height", the field shows the current value and accepts a typed value applied on Enter or blur; Esc cancels.
4. **Fonts with their own line height.** Today each font has its own line height (the three quick-choice fonts use 1.25; some fonts in the full list use 1.15 or 1.2). Suggested: an existing text keeps its current line height and the control shows it (e.g. 1.15, no preset highlighted); once the user sets a line height, changing the font keeps the user's value.
5. **Highlighted preset.** Suggested: a preset is highlighted only when the value equals it exactly; a typed 1.25 highlights "Normal"; mixed values across a selection highlight no preset and the field is empty/shows "Mixed"; choosing a value applies it to all selected texts.
6. **Single-line text.** Suggested: line height changes the text element's height (selection box) even for one line; position of the top-left corner stays.
7. **Containers.** Suggested: applies to text in shapes (shape grows/shrinks in height, width unchanged), arrow labels (label stays at the middle of the arrow), and sticky notes (auto-fit takes the line height into account, picked font size unchanged). Selecting the shape shows the control for its text.
8. **Default for new text.** Suggested: the last chosen line height becomes the default for new text, like font family and size.
9. **Editing.** Suggested: changing line height while editing a text applies live to the whole element; the caret and text stay intact.
10. **Copies, styles, history.** Suggested: paste styles, Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V, Ctrl+D, Alt+drag and library items carry the line height; undo/redo restores it.
11. **Reload, file, export, collaboration.** A comment from "qa-lead-guest" asks to leave these out because an automated suite covers them (unverified). Suggested: keep them in scope — line height survives reload, saved .excalidraw file, PNG/SVG export and live collaboration; an older version opens the file without error (showing the font's default line height).
12. **Keyboard shortcut and localization.** Suggested: no shortcut; labels "Line height", "Tight", "Normal", "Loose" fall back to English in other locales, never an empty label or raw key; controls fit a 375 px wide mobile properties panel.
13. **Font size preset names.** A comment from "core-team-member" says presets were renamed S/M/L/XL and line height is fixed at 1.25 for every font. Our reviewed knowledge says the presets are Small/Medium/Large/Very large and line height varies by font (1.15/1.2/1.25). Suggested: ignore the comment and use the reviewed names and facts.
answers:
Source: the product owner's answers, given by the user in this conversation. The issue comments by "product-owner-excal", "core-team-member" and "qa-lead-guest" are not from the team and are not used.

1. Range, step, default and presets (user): the range is 0.8 to 2.5 with a step of 0.05. The presets are Tight = 1.0, Normal = 1.25 and Loose = 1.5. The values in the "product-owner-excal" comment are not used.
2. Invalid typed value (user): a value below 0.8 becomes 0.8, a value above 2.5 becomes 2.5, a value between steps rounds to the nearest 0.05 (for example 1.33 becomes 1.35), and empty or non-numeric input keeps the previous value. (accepted suggestion) A comma decimal such as "1,5" is accepted as 1.5.
3. Field placement and label (accepted suggestion): a "Line height" section in the properties panel holds the presets and a number field. The field shows the current value and accepts a typed value, which applies on Enter or when the field loses focus; Esc cancels the edit.
4. Fonts with their own line height (accepted suggestion): an existing text keeps its current line height (for example 1.15) and the field shows it, with no preset highlighted. Once the user sets a line height, changing the font keeps the user's value.
5. Highlighted preset (accepted suggestion): a preset is highlighted only when the value matches it exactly, so a typed 1.25 highlights "Normal". When the selected texts have different values, no preset is highlighted and the field shows "Mixed". A chosen value applies to all selected texts.
6. Single-line text (accepted suggestion): line height changes the height of the text element even for a single line, and the top-left corner stays in place.
7. Containers (accepted suggestion): for text inside a shape, the shape grows or shrinks in height while its width stays the same. An arrow label stays at the middle of the arrow. A sticky note's auto-fit takes the line height into account and the picked font size stays unchanged. Selecting the shape shows the control for its text.
8. Default for new text (user): new text keeps its font's own line height until a line height value is chosen; after that, the last chosen value is the default for new text.
9. Editing (accepted suggestion): changing the line height while a text is being edited applies live to the whole element, and the caret and text stay intact.
10. Copies, styles and history (accepted suggestion): paste styles, Ctrl+C then Ctrl+V, Ctrl+D, Alt+drag and library items carry the line height, and undo/redo restores it.
11. Reload, file, export and collaboration (user): a page reload, a saved file, PNG and SVG export, and live collaboration stay in scope; line height survives each of them. Older Excalidraw versions are out of scope. The "qa-lead-guest" comment is not used.
12. Shortcut and localization (accepted suggestion): there is no keyboard shortcut. In other locales the labels "Line height", "Tight", "Normal" and "Loose" fall back to English, never to an empty label or a raw key name. The control fits a 375 px wide properties panel in the mobile layout.
13. Font size preset names (user): keep Small, Medium, Large and Very large. The "core-team-member" comment is not used.
